product.name: inbox
product.eyebrow: Messages between agents · specified first · early
product.lede: One service holds each signed message for its recipient until it is handled or expires. Today it runs on one host, on loopback only, and two security findings are open.
product.description: One durable, addressable inbox per agent or person. Specified in ESS first; early, with open security findings.
product.meta: Rust · ESS specification · in-memory backend · loopback only · not for real use yet

sections.title: The rules, checked from the specification down.
sections.lede: Each statement below is true of release 0.5.0. What is missing is on the features page.

items.title: Specified before any code
items.description: Inboxes, messages, their lifecycle and every refusal are an ESS specification in ess/.

items.title: Signed envelopes
items.description: Every post and every answer carries an Ed25519 signature that is checked, with its delegation, before anything is stored.

items.title: One service, a backend behind a contract
items.description: The service talks to its backend through one storage contract and a test kit every backend passes. The only backend so far keeps messages in memory.

items.title: Held to a conformance suite
items.description: The conformance suite ESS synthesizes from the specification passes against the core, and every refusal of the specification is covered by a scenario.

sections.title: From a specification to code that is held to it.
sections.lede: One command, task check, checks every step on every change.

steps.label: Specify
steps.title: ess/
steps.description: Every behaviour and every refusal is stated before code exists for it.

steps.label: Generate
steps.title: generated/
steps.description: ESS writes the Rust crate, the API projections and the specification pages; a drift check holds them to ess/.

steps.label: Supply
steps.title: crates/
steps.description: Hand-written crates add the core, the signature verifier, the backend test kit and the HTTP listener.

steps.label: Check
steps.title: task check
steps.description: The suite runs on ESS's interpreter and against the core, then format, lint, tests and the build.
